units: <cite ref="Tractate Soferim 17:4">Treat. Sof’rim XVII, 4</cite> <he>ימי הצ׳</he> fast-days.

<cite ref="Rosh Hashanah 18b:1">R. Hash. 18ᵇ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Zechariah 8:19">Zech. VIII, 19</cite>) <he>בזמן שיש … אין שלום צ׳</he> when there is peace, these days shall be days of joy &c., when there is no peace, they shall be fast-days; a. e.—Pl. <cite ref="R00200"><he>צוֹמוֹת</he></cite>, <he>צוֹמִין</he>.
<cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 10:10:1">Koh. R. to X, 10</cite> <he>יגזרו צ׳ ותעניות</he> let them decree fasts and afflictions.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Beitzah 2:8:3">Y. Bets. II, end, 61ᵈ</cite> <he>מן הצ׳ ומן התעניות</he> (not <he>התענית</he>) from fasts and &c.
